metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the handing of the book, Gaunt, the Rose bill, and the three leaves in the chest.

yesterday: Fifty leaves went to Garnish. One woman, the Lady. The fan-carrier's roll is to carry the player's own name. Twenty-odd parts. Three boys.
The two hours remain a lie he will live with. The company reading and the seven shillings both stand over.
You were Gaunt at two. The Rose played the first Tamburlaine, and that play stayed in the ear.
The three cut leaves are still in Garnish's chest.
You still have the book. Heminges has not paid the seven shillings. The three leaves stay in the chest.
